nodes.summary: The BLUP `ĝ = G V⁻¹ (y - X β̂)` of the genetic effects, with `G = σ_g² K` (Henderson 1975).
nodes.title: Best linear unbiased predictor of genetic effects

nodes.summary: Coordinate ascent along the update schedule `s`: at time `t` factor `s t` is updated.
nodes.title: Coordinate ascent along an update schedule

nodes.summary: One coordinate-ascent step: replace factor `j` by its CAVI update.
nodes.title: One coordinate-ascent step

nodes.summary: The CAVI update of factor `j`: the prior tilted by the potential, `qⱼ ∝ π · exp fⱼ = exp 𝔼_{q_{-j}}[log p(y, β)]`.
nodes.title: Coordinate-ascent update of one variational factor

nodes.summary: The squared norm `‖xⱼ‖² = ∑ᵢ X i j ²` of the genotype column of SNP `j`.
nodes.title: Squared norm of a genotype column

nodes.summary: Coordinate ascent does not decrease the ELBO.
nodes.title: Coordinate ascent does not decrease the ELBO

nodes.summary: Replacing factor `j` by an admissible `q'` gives `ELBO(caviStep q j) - KL(q' ‖ caviUpdate q j)`.
nodes.title: The CAVI update maximizes the ELBO over its factor, with exact gap

nodes.summary: The mean-field evidence lower bound `-(n/2) log (2π σ_e²) - 𝔼_q ‖y - X β‖² / (2 σ_e²) - ∑ⱼ KL(qⱼ ‖ π)`, meaningful for `σ_e² > 0`. It is the ELBO for admissible factors (finite KL); for an inadmissible factor `toReal` would turn an infinite divergence into `0`, so all results assume admissibility.
nodes.title: Mean-field evidence lower bound

nodes.summary: With the other factors fixed, the ELBO of `q` with factor `j` replaced by an admissible `q'` is `∫ fⱼ dq' - KL(q' ‖ π) + C`.
nodes.title: The ELBO as a function of one factor

nodes.summary: The expected residual sum of squares `‖y - X μ‖² + ∑ⱼ ‖xⱼ‖² vⱼ` of the product of the factors `q`, with means `μⱼ` and variances `vⱼ` (`integral_rss_pi`).
nodes.title: Expected residual sum of squares under the variational factors

nodes.summary: The generalized least-squares estimator `β̂ = (Xᵀ V⁻¹ X)⁻¹ Xᵀ V⁻¹ y`.
nodes.title: Generalized least-squares estimator

nodes.summary: The score of a SNP effect at `γ = 0` is `xᵀ P y`.
nodes.title: The score of a SNP effect

nodes.summary: The information `xᵀ P x` is positive when the SNP `x` is not in the column space of `X`.
nodes.title: Information of a SNP outside the column space of $X$ is positive

nodes.summary: The mixture prior has a finite second moment.
nodes.title: Mixture prior has finite second moment

nodes.summary: For probability factors with finite second moments, `𝔼_{∏ qⱼ} ‖y - X β‖² = ‖y - X μ‖² + ∑ⱼ ‖xⱼ‖² vⱼ`.
nodes.title: The expected residual sum of squares of a product of factors

nodes.summary: The CAVI update is an admissible factor, for a probability prior with a finite second moment.
nodes.title: Coordinate-ascent update is an admissible factor

nodes.summary: An admissible variational factor for the prior `π`: a probability measure with a finite second moment and finite KL divergence from `π` (`q ≪ π` with integrable log-likelihood ratio).
nodes.title: Admissible variational factor

nodes.summary: No admissible change of factor `j` increases the ELBO iff `qⱼ` is the expected-log-joint update `π · exp fⱼ / Z`.
nodes.title: Stationary points of coordinate ascent

nodes.summary: For positive definite `K`, `σ_g² > 0` and `X` of full column rank, `(β, g)` solves the mixed-model equations iff `β = β̂` and `g = σ_g² K V⁻¹ (y - X β̂)`. This is the specialization of `MixedModel.isMMESolution_iff_gls` to `Z = 1`, `G = σ_g² K`, `R = σ_e² I`; the generic theorem gives `β = glsMatrix X V *ᵥ y` and `g = G V⁻¹ (y - X β̂)`, which are `Model.gls` and `Model.blup` by the two conversion lemmas below.
nodes.title: Henderson's mixed-model equations give the GLS estimator and the BLUP

nodes.summary: `(β, g)` solves Henderson's mixed-model equations with `R = σ_e² I` and `G = σ_g² K`, i.e. the specialization of `MixedModel.IsMMESolution` to `Z = 1` (every individual has its own genetic effect), `G = σ_g² K`, `R = σ_e² I`. In unfolded form this is `Xᵀ R⁻¹ X β + Xᵀ R⁻¹ g = Xᵀ R⁻¹ y` and `R⁻¹ X β + (R⁻¹ + G⁻¹) g = R⁻¹ y`. The equations are meaningful when `G` is invertible (`isMMESolution_iff`); otherwise `G⁻¹` is…
nodes.title: Solution of Henderson's mixed-model equations

nodes.summary: The mixture prior is a probability measure for a mixing weight `p ≤ 1`.
nodes.title: Mixture prior is a probability measure

nodes.summary: For `X` of full column rank, `X β` attains the maximal marginal log-likelihood only at `β = β̂`.
nodes.title: The GLS maximizer is unique

nodes.summary: The maximal marginal log-likelihood is `-(n log 2π + log det V + yᵀ P y) / 2`.
nodes.title: Maximal marginal log-likelihood

nodes.summary: For `X` of full column rank, every mean `X β` has marginal log-likelihood at most that of the GLS fit `X β̂`.
nodes.title: GLS maximizes the marginal likelihood

nodes.summary: The marginal log-likelihood of the mean `μ`: the log of the `N(μ, V)` density at `y`, `-(n log 2π + log det V + (y - μ)ᵀ V⁻¹ (y - μ)) / 2` (`det V > 0` by `posDef_V`).
nodes.title: Marginal log-likelihood of the mean

nodes.summary: The mean `∫ b dq` of a factor.
nodes.title: Mean of a variational factor

nodes.summary: The BOLT-LMM prior on a SNP effect: the mixture `p N(0, v₁) + (1 - p) N(0, v₂)` of two centered Gaussians with variances `v₁, v₂` (`v₂ = 0` gives the spike-and-slab prior with a point mass at `0`).
nodes.title: Two-Gaussian mixture prior on a SNP effect

nodes.summary: The variance components of the linear mixed model `y = X β + g + e` with `g ~ N(0, σ_g² K)` and `e ~ N(0, σ_e² I)` on `n` individuals: a positive semidefinite genetic relationship matrix `K`, a genetic variance `σ_g² ≥ 0` and an environmental variance `σ_e² > 0`.
nodes.title: Variance components of the linear mixed model

nodes.summary: The ELBO is nondecreasing along coordinate ascent, for any update schedule.
nodes.title: The ELBO is nondecreasing along coordinate ascent

nodes.summary: The partial residual `rⱼ = y - ∑_{k ≠ j} xₖ μₖ` of the other SNPs' posterior means.
nodes.title: Partial residual of a SNP

nodes.summary: `V = σ_g² K + σ_e² I` is positive definite.
nodes.title: Positive definiteness of the phenotypic covariance

nodes.summary: The CAVI potential `fⱼ(b) = (b xⱼᵀ rⱼ - ‖xⱼ‖² b² / 2) / σ_e²`: the part of the expected log-likelihood `𝔼_{q_{-j}}[log p(y | β)]` that depends on `βⱼ = b` (`exists_elbo_update_eq`).
nodes.title: Coordinate-ascent potential for one SNP effect

nodes.summary: `ℓ(γ) = ℓ(0) + γ xᵀ P y - γ² xᵀ P x / 2`, so its score at `γ = 0` is `xᵀ P y` and its information is `xᵀ P x`.
nodes.title: The profile log-likelihood of a SNP effect is an exact quadratic

nodes.summary: The profile marginal log-likelihood of a SNP effect `γ` for the SNP genotype vector `x`: `sup_β logLik y (X β + γ x)`.
nodes.title: Profile log-likelihood of a SNP effect

nodes.summary: `P V P = P`. With `P X = 0`, this says that under the null model `y = X β + ε` with `Cov ε = V` the score `xᵀ P y = xᵀ P ε` has variance `xᵀ P V P x = xᵀ P x`.
nodes.title: Identity $PVP = P$ for the residual-forming matrix

nodes.summary: `P X = 0`: the residual-forming matrix annihilates the fixed effects.
nodes.title: Residual-forming matrix annihilates the fixed effects

nodes.summary: The residual-forming matrix `P = V⁻¹ - V⁻¹ X (Xᵀ V⁻¹ X)⁻¹ Xᵀ V⁻¹`.
nodes.title: Residual-forming matrix

nodes.summary: The score is evaluated at the null GLS fit: `xᵀ P y = xᵀ V⁻¹ (y - X β̂)`.
nodes.title: Score at the null generalized least-squares fit

nodes.summary: The score statistic `(xᵀ P y)² / (xᵀ P x)` for one SNP `x`. Its denominator is positive when `x` is not in the column space of `X` (`info_pos`); otherwise the statistic is `0` by the convention `a / 0 = 0` and carries no information.
nodes.title: Score statistic for one SNP

nodes.summary: The marginal phenotypic covariance `V = σ_g² K + σ_e² I` of `y = X β + g + e`.
nodes.title: Marginal phenotypic covariance matrix

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
